observations: Photo 0: a black stacked mini hi-fi head unit on a dusty floor: 3 disc CD changer on top, a display/tuner section, an amplifier section with a volume knob, and a double cassette deck (A and B) at the bottom.
Photo 0: the word 'MINISTAR' is printed on the amplifier panel; the line of small text under it and the small logo at the lower right are not readable.
Photo 0: the whole unit is covered in thick dust and grime, the cassette B window looks cracked or soiled, and a piece of paper is stuck in the cassette A area.
Photo 0: no speakers, no remote and no power cable connection to the unit are shown; a loose cable lies on the floor to the right.
Photo 0: nothing is powered on; the display is dark.
The seller's own description says it is scrap, not functioning, sold as is for parts or recycling.

identity.kind: 3 disc CD mini hi-fi stereo system with double cassette, head unit only, scrap
read_from: photo 0 front panel: '3 DISC', 'MINISTAR' label, A/B cassette decks

claims.claim: Scrap compact audio system, currently not functioning, sold as is for parts or recycling
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a dusty, dark unit consistent with scrap; whether it powers on cannot be seen. Accepted as the worst case it describes.
Photo 0 shows heavy dust, grime and a damaged cassette window; the seller's own description calls it scrap.
No photo of the case screws or rear panel; cannot be judged remotely.
The seller's own description says it is not functioning; photo 0 shows no power or display.
No receipt or warranty card is shown; an old, dusty scrap unit is unlikely to carry a live warranty.

risks.risk: Unit does not power on or play at all
risks.proof: A clip of the unit plugged in, display lit, playing a CD and a cassette through speakers
risks.if_unproven: as not working, scrap for parts

risks.risk: Speakers missing; only the head unit is offered
risks.proof: A photo of both matching speakers next to the unit
risks.if_unproven: as head unit only, no speakers

risks.risk: Internal parts (transformer, boards, CD mechanism) already removed
risks.proof: A photo of the rear panel and a photo with the top cover off showing the transformer and boards in place
risks.if_unproven: as a stripped shell, lowest scrap grade

risks.proof: A photo of the rear panel with the power cable attached and any remote

proof_requests: A clip of the unit plugged in and switched on, display lit, playing a CD
A photo of the rear panel and of the inside with the top cover off
A photo of the speakers if they are included
A close photo of the brand and model label on the front or back
response.reason: The item is plainly a 3 disc mini hi-fi head unit and the seller describes it as non-working scrap, so it can be priced at that worst case. The 'like new, works perfectly' line is contradicted by the photo and the seller's own description, so it cannot raise the price.
